alt: 登山者站在狹窄山徑中間，前方木橋斷裂，後方被倒下的枝幹堵住。
scene_prompt: A hiker on a narrow woodland path is trapped between two clearly different obstacles: ahead a small footbridge is broken over a creek, behind a fresh tangle of fallen branches blocks the only path back. Hiker stands in the small open middle space looking worriedly from one side to the other, empty hands spread in uncertainty. Wide side view shows both directions impossible; no cliffs or injury, no arbitrary crossroads choice.
